Ujaas Energy Limited, under its flagship 'UJAAS' brand, is engaged in the development, sale, and operation of solar power projects across engineering, procurement and construction (EPC), solar park, and rooftop solar segments, along with operations and maintenance (O&M) services . The Company has also recently ventured into the electric two-wheeler segment with the launch of its 'E-Spa' electric scooter.

evidence.VEDPOWER: Vedanta Power is the power generation business of Vedanta Group. It operates large thermal power assets and supplies electricity to industries and state utilities across India.
evidence.VOLTAMP: Voltamp Transformers Ltd is a Baroda based company and is mainly into manufacturing of various types of Oil filled Power & Distribution Transformers of various classes. Business Segments - FY26 a) Products (96%): The company’s product portfolio comprises oil-filled power and distribution transformers up to 120 MVA , dry-type transformers up to 10 MVA , compact substations up to 2.5 MVA , 33 KV Class and ring main units of 12 KV, 630 Amps . The company reported a total sales volume of 16,514 MVA in FY26, up from 15,460 MVA in FY25.
evidence.WAAREEINDO: Incorporated in 2005, Indosolar Ltd manufactures PV solar modules. Business. Indosolar Limited, a subsidiary of Waaree Energies Limited, operates as a solar PV module manufacturer. Indosolar Limited is an Indian photovoltaic cell and solar panel manufacturer. Following insolvency proceedings, it was acquired by Waaree Energies in 2022.
